hypothesis: If LoRA-init variance causes step-0 saturation, gating adapter to steps 0..N-1 should reduce fire-rate or delay fire-step.
mechanism_reframe: Pre-equilibrium argmax concentration is RAPID-post-LoRA-update (1-2 steps), not LoRA-init-static. Naive activation gating does not prevent saturation; the mechanism is the first gradient update against pretrained DLM logits.
result: NEGATIVE — gating to step 5 and step 10 does NOT change fire-rate (100% all) or fire-step (median 11 all). Saturation forms within 1-2 LoRA training updates after activation, not from static LoRA-init.
schema: K15f prospective LoRA-activation-gating intervention on MDLM-OWT 130M
